items.title: Divi's Laboratories Q4 Results: Cons PAT grows 13% YoY to Rs 751 crore, revenue up 10%; Rs 30 per share dividend announced
items.description: Divi's Laboratories Q4 Results:  Divi's Laboratories announced strong financial results for the March quarter. Net profit rose 13% to Rs 751 crore. Revenue from operations increased 10% to Rs 2,831 crore. The company recommended a final dividend of Rs 30 per equity share for FY26. Full-year profit after tax stood at Rs 2,568 crore.
